description: Use when choosing HOW to integrate. Returns each interface with its URL, auth and when to pick it: REST + OpenAPI 3.1 (backend apps, Bearer key), public demo key and keyless sandbox (try without signup), installable Agent Skill (coding agents), this public discovery MCP (product questions only, no auth) and the authenticated operational MCP (agents that read authorized accounts with an rpg_mcp_ token). Takes no parameters. Read-only. Use connecta_getting_started instead when the user wants the ordered steps to go live.
name: connecta_integration_options
title: RPG Connecta integration options
